verdicts.note: Said 100,000 is 'the nearest hundred, only 50 away', but 99,900 is also 50 away; it is a tie settled by round-half-up. Reworded to say so.
'Two primes are always relatively prime' is false for equal primes (gcd(7,7)=7). Changed to 'two different primes'.
Defined integer as a 'whole number' that may be negative, which is circular and clashes with later use of whole numbers as non-negative. Reworded to 'a number with no fractional part'.
